summary: Frontend-only verification of approved artwork rollout for the 5 GroovLabz apps. All artwork loads (naturalWidth>0), per-app frame ratios render on home/apps/detail. GroovBox is the ONLY detail page with app-detail-landscape (correct). Gallery counts correct: groovsesh=3, groovmash=2, groovbox/groovtrackz/groovcharts=0. All /jamnow/*.png|jpg static assets return 200. Regression: hero-groovsesh-screen-link, home-guitar-stage, /shop 200, /account login (admin@groovlabz.com/admin123) working. One issue found: horizontal overflow at 390px viewport caused by the closed cart-drawer aside.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px viewport, document.scrollWidth=426 vs clientWidth=390 (36px horizontal overflow). Root cause: [data-testid="cart-drawer"] aside is fixed top-0 right-0 w-full and stays laid out in the flow at right:0, extending past viewport when hidden. Home cards themselves render correctly as 2 columns (both cards at y=1890, x=16/205), so the overflow is exclusively from the drawer. Spec explicitly requires no horizontal overflow at 390px.

action_items: Add overflow-x:hidden to body OR translate cart-drawer off-screen via transform (not positional) OR conditionally render/set display:none when closed, so it doesn't inflate scrollWidth at 390px.
critical_code_review_comments: AppScreen renders artwork via with per-app frame [W,H]; ratios are consistent and images load with naturalWidth ≥512 for all 5 apps. Good.
AppDetail correctly gates gallery on app.gallery and landscape on app.landscape. GroovBox uniquely shows app-detail-landscape as required.
Cart drawer accessibility: since always in DOM at right:0 w-full, consider aria-hidden + transform to keep it out of layout bounds.
test_credentials: admin@groovlabz.com / admin123 (verified working; redirects to /account on submit)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All artwork-related checks from this iteration pass. Only outstanding item is a 36px horizontal overflow at 390px caused by the fixed cart-drawer aside (w-full at right:0 while closed). Not caused by app cards (they wrap to 2 columns correctly).
